hypotheses.C0_context_tensor_recomposes_native_fact: The contracted output-by-tangent-by-context tensor matches direct projected native factors to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.C1_context_axes_have_transferable_semant: Frozen per-axis context explanations have median AUROC at least 0.60 on FineWeb, WikiText, and TinyStories.
hypotheses.C2_context_axes_are_more_semantic_than_r: Native context axes exceed the same-subspace rotation p95 median AUROC by at least 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C3_local_operators_are_low_rank: Median per-site 90%-energy rank of the 16-by-16 tangent-to-output operator is at most 8 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_eight_context_modes_are_sufficient: The first eight tensor-ordered context coordinates retain at least 0.90 local-operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.C5_current_token_routes_operator: A discovery-frozen exact-current-token lookup retains at least 0.50 operator fidelity on FineWeb and 0.30 on both OOD corpora, with coverage at least 0.50.
hypotheses.C6_coarse_token_routes_operator: A discovery-frozen coarse current-token lookup retains at least 0.20 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.C7_mean_operator_is_insufficient: A single discovery-mean operator retains at most 0.80 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.C8_full_state_is_an_exact_control_regist: The observed context coordinates reproduce every local operator to numerical precision by construction; lexical routers are judged against this explicit upper bound.
